verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party rule or automation builder in folk where a user defines event-triggered actions. Webhooks only deliver event notifications to an external URL, which is a developer building block for constructing automation elsewhere. Auto-import/sync integrations and email sequences are adjacent features, not user-defined event-to-action rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
